about_the_game:
The IT Specialist Training Program for Trainees and Career Changers ;)

This program was developed by the two of us (Jakub and Patrick) during our own career change training. It is designed to help others pass the AP1 exam.

The current question catalog in the game focuses on the topics relevant to the first exam. This means that other professions (such as IT system electronics technicians) can also use this trainer.

Since we are developing this privately as a two-person team, please be considerate of the program's quality. At the moment, it does not include sound effects or elaborate graphics. Bugs may occur, but in general, the game should run without issues.

Features:

  • Random questions from the entire question catalog

  • Questions focused on specific topics (e.g., hardware, project management, etc.)

  • Time limit and points system

  • (Theoretically) playable on Steam Deck

  • Controller support (tested: Xbox controller) should work

For additional planned features, please refer to the Early Access section. Depending on our available time, we will update the program from time to time.

Note: The program is only available in German.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Pentium Silver N5030 1.10 Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 605
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: -
  • Additional Notes: Above is the lowest test system what we got, runs most likely with every system. Also runs on Linux (with Proton) and Steam Deck
